ios.desc:
PBJ Live Video Streaming app is an end-to-end streaming solution that allows you to easily stream to your website or app through the PBJ Live SDK. 

PBJ Live offering includes: 

• Reach your audience by embedding our Livestream SDK for iOS and Web in any of your websites or apps
• On-the-go streaming — use our PBJ Live iOS app or any streaming software
• Multiple concurrent streams
• Simulcast to all RTMP supported social platforms

Interested in more features? Our enterprise solution provides: 

• Custom branded Web and Mobile apps with live streaming and categorized video on demand content
• Flexible subscription plans for monetized live and on demand experiences
• Featured products for sale through Shopify during live streams
• Chat with viewers through in-session messages and Q&A

Read more about our terms of use: https://pbj.live/terms

quotes.text:
Hi HN! Joe and Paul here to share PBJ Live. We're releasing an SDK which adds end-to-end live streaming capabilities to any app or website in minutes.

Once the SDK is installed, PBJ Live allows you to create, manage and schedule live broadcasts, categorize past streams or recorded content (coming soon), issue permissions to streamers and even simulcast (soon) to other platforms all through your pbj.live account. To avoid hardware and RTMP headaches, we've paired the platform with a live stream app for a convenient way to broadcast.

About us: We're two of the three founders behind PBJ Studio, a product studio formed by a close group who have worked together for 6+ years. Outside of client work, we build our own products, the first of which is PBJ Live.

PBJ Live is the result of our painfully repetitive experience building a half dozen custom live stream products for clients. We found there were quite a few common features, outside of the actual stream provider (thanks, Mux!), we needed to build to support streaming. Once COVID hit, we had an increase in requests for custom live stream solutions. Initially, we built the platform and paired it with iOS, Web and Android apps which we'd customize. Today, we're releasing our Live SDK so anyone can easily add live streaming to their own apps and take advantage of the Live platform.
